evidence.method: Decoded completed-job logs parsed for Bun summary counters, explicit skipped test names, actual Node smoke marker, Playwright final suite summaries and retry markers. Every ordinary job source SHA, GitHub attempt and start/completion time independently checked against the detailed jobs API.
evidence.unitTurboExecution: Both unit logs report Cached:0 cached,8 total; emitted Bun counters are suite invocation counts, not deduplicated cross-suite totals. HttpApi counts remain separate.

scope: All fifteen ordinary JavaScript, actual Node bundle and browser regression jobs succeeded in GitHub job attempt1 on the exact recorded source. No GitHub job retry or internal Playwright retry was executed. The overall workflow concluded failure in the separate Windows native build step. This record grants no native, packaged artifact, signing, manual OS or release approval.
